releases.notes: Chat search finds a chat by its title first and answers in a numbered, structured way; open a result by number (go to the first / second result, also after opening a wrong chat); long press a chat to rename it.

Stop keeps the music queue and place ('resume' plays on), new 'clear the queue' command; 'stop the playback, please' and other polite words anywhere in a short command; the assistant no longer says it will remember without saving; links to the program site, the guide and all voice commands in Settings.

Timer through the model and short phrases up to 8 words; fast phrases after a past-chat search (more, previous results, open the second one); weather, time, timer and similar exchanges are marked as commands unless you say 'keep this in the chat'.
